title: Item Exchange!
body: After a long day of fucking around with shit I was able to finally complete what is exactly what I wanted for the longest time. A complete fully working in game exchange where custom items can be sent to gain wanted items. You can now go to https://wow.nekos.farm/exchange.php to view all current exchanges. The quick how-to is in game open your mailbox send mail to Exchange and the subject line must include the code on the website the only one there currently is TOAC. then attach the needed items. Once sent after a few seconds you'll get your item. If you mess up the subject line or send over the amount or under the amount the bot will return your items to you. This is my first custom wow feature I've ever made that's completely in game. :D
